errors.text: The proposed equiatomic AlCoCrFeNi single-phase BCC starting material is not the target as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic alloy containing FCC and B2 phases.
The central L2_1 ordering mechanism is incompatible with the target mechanism of enhanced L1_2 ordering in FCC domains coupled to jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries.
The proposed recovery temperature of 1000 °C and 600–1000 °C treatment range miss the target 550–750 °C transition window and recovery near 750 °C.
No cited evidence establishes the required prior observation of temperature-dependent chemical ordering, much less L2_1 ordering correlated with ductility, in the proposed composition.

The hypothesis omits the phase-boundary morphology, dislocation pile-ups, planar slip, and crack initiation at jagged boundary tips that distinguish the target mechanism from generic ordering embrittlement.
